subject: general
question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Coarse
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e.** 'Buttery'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Coarse"** is an adjective that describes something rough, crude or of low quality.(कठोर)
 
• It can also be** used to** describe someone's manners as rude or vulgar. 
 
• **Buttery: "**Buttery" usually describes something that is smooth, creamy, or has the qualities of butter.(मक्खन की तरह स्मूथ)
 
• When considering textures, **"buttery"** is the** opposite** of "**coarse**", as it implies a smooth and pleasing quality.

The **correct answer** is: **'Buttery'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Devoted:** The term 'devoted' refers to having strong love or loyalty for someone or something.(समर्पित)
 
• **Unrefined:** This term refers to something in its raw or original state, not processed or purified. (अपरिष्कृत)
 
• **Gruntled: **This term is rather unusual but means pleased, satisfied, or contented. (संतुष्ट)
